annotations.title: Note what was suggested about merchants

description: Remember what this conversation suggested for merchants that were **not** categorized — a category the user declined, or a name nobody could identify — so the next conversation does not ask about the same names again. Shown in the Asked about column of uncategorized_merchants, cleared automatically when a merchant is categorized. Writes immediately: it changes no transaction, no category and no rule.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

suggestions.description: One entry per merchant. Up to 200 in a call.

category_id.description: The category the note is about. Required unless the status is NO_SUGGESTION.

merchant.description: The normalized merchant name, exactly as `uncategorized_merchants` printed it.

note.description: One line of why, in your own words. Shown to the next reader.

status.description: SUGGESTED (offered, not yet acted on), DECLINED (offered and refused — do not offer that category again), or NO_SUGGESTION (looked at, nothing to say).

name: note_merchant_suggestions
title: Note what was suggested about merchants
